Managing LLM Provider Credentials for AI Guard
AI Guard
Managing LLM Provider Credentials for AI Guard
Ask Zscaler

After adding a Large Language Model (LLM) model provider to AI Guard in Proxy mode, you must add the LLM provider credentials to authenticate with your LLM providers. To learn more about adding LLM providers, see Managing LLM Providers for AI Guard.

Prerequisites

Before managing LLM provider credentials, access your LLM provider and copy the keys or IAM roles from your LLM provider dashboard.

Adding LLM Provider Credentials

To add the credentials for an LLM provider:

In the left-side navigation, under LLMs, click Credentials. The Credentials page appears, listing any credentials already added for the LLM providers.

See image.

On the Credentials page, click Add More. The Add LLM Credentials window appears.

In the Add LMM Credentials window:

Name: Enter the name for the credential.
LLM Provider: From the drop-down menu, select the LLM provider to associate with this credential.
Expires At: (Optional) Select the date when the credential expires.
API Key: Enter the LLM provider credentials that you copied from your LLM provider dashboard.

See image.

Click Submit.
Editing LLM Provider Credentials

To edit the credentials for an LLM provider:

In the left-side navigation, under LLMs, click Credentials. The Credentials page appears, listing the credentials for the LLM providers.

See image.

On the Credentials page, in the Action column next to a credential, click the Edit icon. The Add LLM Credentials window appears.

In the Add LLM Credentials window, modify any of the credential information.

See image.

Click Submit.
